final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zone_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_diff FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_gb) AS mean_rem FROM g) SELECT g.zone_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_gb, g.avg_cpu_gpu_diff, g.avg_remaining_gb / m.mean_rem AS ratio FROM g, m WHERE m.mean_rem IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (g.avg_remaining_gb / m.mean_rem) IS NULL, g.avg_remaining_gb / m.mean_rem DESC LIMIT 10
